canonical_statement: Every degreewise short exact sequence of homological complexes in an arbitrary abelian category induces connecting morphisms for every adjacent pair of degrees, and the induced homology maps and connecting morphisms are exact at all three repeating positions of the continuing long sequence.
domain_and_universes: C : Type u with Category.{v} C and Abelian C; iota : Type w; c : ComplexShape iota; S : ShortComplex (HomologicalComplex C c)
hypotheses: c.Rel i j for the two connecting-map positions
conclusion: Exactness of homologyMap S.f i followed by homologyMap S.g i for every i, plus exactness on both sides of hS.delta i j hij for every related i,j.
minimal_import_evidence: The target uses ShortComplex.ShortExact.delta, comp_delta, delta_comp and the homology interfaces defined by this direct module; no HomologySequenceLemmas, derived-category, or representation-theory import is used.
